title: P6 Activity Release 26 secondary baseline typed semantic evidence tranche
reference_version: Oracle Primavera P6 EPPM REST API Release 26
certification_rule: This artifact certifies only documented read-side API type, unit, and semantic description. Writable/default/nullability/import-export and stored-vs-computed certification remain open; no Registry identity is changed by this tranche.

fields.description: Duration for the activity in the secondary baseline; total working time from current start to current finish, using the activity calendar.
Current finish date in the user's secondary baseline; Oracle documents planned, remaining, or actual finish depending on activity status.
Planned duration in the secondary baseline; total working time from current start to current finish, using the activity calendar.
Planned costs for project expenses associated with the activity in the secondary baseline.

Oracle Release 26 description for the secondary-baseline field; the published text describes planned costs for project expenses associated with the activity and labels it Baseline Budgeted Expense Cost.
Planned units for all labor resources assigned to the activity in the secondary baseline.
Planned material cost for the activity in the user's secondary baseline.
Planned costs for all nonlabor resources; if no resources are assigned, Oracle documents computation from planned nonlabor units and project default price/time.
Planned units for all nonlabor resources assigned to the activity in the secondary baseline.
Planned total cost in the secondary baseline including labor, nonlabor, and project expenses; total equals planned labor cost + planned nonlabor cost + planned expense cost.
Current start date in the user's secondary baseline; set to planned start until started, then actual start.
